crossRefs.note: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

parallels.note: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

translations.web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
translations.bsb: He immediately got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
translations.kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
translations.asv: And straightway he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
